'''''Citrus japonica''''', the '''round kumquat''',<ref>{{ITIS|id=502643|taxon=Fortunella japonica  (Thunb.) Swingle|access-date=2024-01-26}}</ref><ref>{{PFAF|Citrus japonica}}</ref> '''Marumi kumquat''', or '''Morgani kumquat''', is a [[species]] of citrus fruit in the [[genus]] ''[[Citrus]]''. It was first described by [[Carl Peter Thunberg]] in 1780 as ''Fortunella japonica''.<ref name="ncbi1">{{NCBI taxid|76966|Citrus japonica|accessdate=2024-01-26}}</ref><ref name="POWO" />

''Citrus japonica'' is a native species in southern China.<ref name=POWO>{{BioRef|POWO|id=771939-1|genus=Citrus|species=japonica Thunb.}}</ref>
